interpretation: Unconstrained k-means collapsed 90.25% of observations into one expert and left two severely underdetermined experts. Router classification is not the primary failure; imbalanced expert support and resulting expert-map extrapolation are.
decision: Close unconstrained residual k-means. Authorize one exact replay using deterministic balanced recursive PCA partitioning, changing no experts, rank, ridge, records, checkpoints, validation, or gate.
claim_boundary: Negative layer-1 sparse extraction evidence only; no artifact, certificate, or superiority claim.
